s: sAt
klI, (sAta suKe + kvip .) brahma । iti kecit ॥
m: 1. सात् a Taddhita affix which when put after a word denotes a total change of anything into the thing expressed by that word (see अग्नि-, भस्म-सात् &c.)
2. सात् a Sautra root meaning ‘to give pleasure’, Pāṇ.; Vop.
3. सात् n. N. of Brahman, L.
a: सात् — ind. A Taddhita affix added to a word to show that something is completely changed into the thing expressed by that word, or that it is left at the complete disposal or control of that thing; भस्मसात् भू ‘to be completely reduced to ashes’; अग्निसात्कृत्वा M. 5; भस्मसात्कृतवतः पितृद्विषः पात्रसाच्च वसुधां ससागरां R. 11. 86; विभज्य मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात्कृतः N. 1. 16; so ब्राह्मणसात्, राजसात् &c.; Śi. 14. 36.

m: साता-गिरि m. N. of a Yakṣa, Jātakam.
सातीकाश mfn. with or having excessive light, ĀśvGṛ.

सात्मी in comp. for सात्म.

सात्मी—√ भू P. -भवति, to become a custom or habit, become suitable or salutary, Jātakam.

s: sAtmyaM

tri, suKajanakam । Atmano hitaM karmma AtmyaM Atmyena saha varttamAnaM sAtmyam । iti BEzajyaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, suSrute । 1 । 45 । “sarvvaprARaBftAM tasmAt sAtmyaM kzIramihocyate ॥” “sAtmyaM nAma tadyat sAtatyenopasevyamAnamupaSete । tatra ye DftakzIratElamAMsarasasAtmyAH sarvvarasasAtmyASca te balavantaH kleSasahAH cirajIvinaSca Bavanti । rUkzanityAH punarekarasasAtmyASca ye te prAyeRAlpabalAScAkleSAsahAH alpAyuzo'lpasADanASca .” iti carake vimAnasTAne'zwame'DyAye ॥ “yo rasaH kalpate yasya suKAyEva nizevitaH । vyAyAmajAtamanyadvA tatsAtmyamiti nirddiSet ॥” iti suSrute sUtrasTAne 36 aDyAye ॥ klI, devatvam । yaTA, BAgavate । 6 । 18 । 20 “indreRa prApitAH sAtmyaM kiM tat sADu kftaM hi tEH ॥” sArUpyam । yaTA, tatrEva । 7 । 10 । 40 । “nfpAScEdyAdayaH sAtmyaM harestaccintayA yayuH ॥”)

सात्म्य m. suitableness, wholesomeness, ib.

सात्म्य m. community of essence or nature with (instr. or gen.), BhP.

सातोबार्हत mfn. relating or belonging to the Sato-bṛhatī metre, Lāṭy.
सात्पुडा f. N. of a mountain, VP.
सात्राजिती (ई), f. patr. of Satya-bhāmā, MBh.; Hariv.

patr. of Śoṇa, ŚBr.
N. of a place g. धूमादि.

puM, BUmni, deSaBedaH । yaTA, -- “yadavastu daSArhAH syuH sAttvatAH kukurASca te .” iti trikARqaSezaH ॥

strI, nAwakavfttiviSezaH । yaTA, -- “aBineyaprakArAH syurBAzAH zaw saMskftAdikAH । BAratI sAttvatI kESikyAraBawyO ca vfttayaH ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, SfNgAratilake । 3 । 42 -- 43 । “harzapraDAnADikasattvavfttistyAgottarodAravacomanojYA । AScaryyasampatsuBagA ca yA syAtsA sAttvatI nAma matAtra vfttiH ॥ nAtigUQArTasampattiH SravyaSabdamanoramA । vIre rOdre'dBute SAnte vfttirezA matA yaTA ॥ lakzmyAstvaM janako niDiSca payasAM niHSezaratnAkaro maryAdAniratastvameva jalaDe ! brUte'tra ko'nyAdfSam । kiM tvekasya gfhaM gatasya baqavAvahneH sadA tfzRayA klAntasyodarapUraRe'pi na saho yattanmanANmaDyamam ॥ sPAritotkawakaWoratArakAkIrRavahnikaRasaMtatiH kruDA । durnimittataqidAkftirbaBO dfzwirizwasamarAMSumAlinaH ॥ atyadButaM narADipa tava kIrtirDavalayantya'pi jaganti । raktAn karoti suhfdo malinayati ca vErivadanAni ॥ nivfttavizayAsaNgamaDunA sucirAya me । Atmanyeva samADAnaM manaH kevalamicCati ॥” * ॥ sAttvatasyApatyaM strI । sAttvata + aY । NIp .) SiSupAlamAtA । iti kecit ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 45 । 6 । “eza naH SatruratyantaM pArTivAH sAttvatIsutaH । sAttvatAnAM nfSaMSAtmA na hito'napakAriRAm ॥” suBadrA । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 222 । 66 ॥ “sa sAttvatyAmaDiraTaH sambaBUva DanaYjayAt । maKe nirmaTaneneva SamIgarBAdDutASanaH ॥”)
sAttva(tva)taH

puM, (sAttvatasyApatyaM pumAniti । sAttvata + aY .) baladevaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (kfzRaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 219 । 12 । “tatastatra mahAbAhuH SayAnaH Sayane SuBe । ApagAnAM vanAnAYca kaTayAmAsa sAttvate ॥” yAdavamAtre । yaTA, tatrEva । 1 । 222 । 3 । “arTalubDAn na vaH pArTo manyate sAttvatAn sadA । svayaMvaramanADfzyaM manyate cApi pARqavaH ॥” * ॥ sattvameva sAttvaM tat tanotIti । tana + qaH .) vizRuH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (sacCabdena sattvamUrttirBagavAn । sa upAsyatayA vidyate 'syeti । matup । tataH svArTe aR .) vizRuBaktaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “sattvaM sattvASrayaM sattvaguRaM seveta keSavam । yo'nanyatvena manasA sAttvataH samudAhftaH ॥ vihAya kAmyakarmmAdIn BajedekAkinaM harim । satyaM sattvaguRopeto BaktyA taM sAttvataM viduH ॥ mukundapAdasevAyAM tannAmaSravaRe'pi ca । kIrttane ca rato Bakto nAmnaH syAt smaraRe hareH ॥ vandanArccanayorBaktiraniSaM dAsyasaKyayoH । ratirAtmArpaRe yasya dfQAnantasya sAttvataH ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe 99 aDyAyaH ॥ * ॥ yaduvaMSIyasattvatarAjaputtraH । yaTA, -- “anostu purukutso'BUdaMSustasya tu rikTaBAk । aTAMSoH sattvato nAma vizRuBaktaH pratApavAn ॥ mahAtmA dAnanirato DanurvvedavidAM varaH । sa nAradasya vacanAdvAsudevArccanAnvitaH ॥ SAstraM pravarttayAmAsa kuRqagolAdiBiH Srutam । tasya nAmnA tu viKyAtaM sAttvataM nAma SoBanam ॥ pravarttate mahASAstraM kuRqAdInAM hitAvaham । sAttvatastasya puttro'BUt sarvvaSAstraviSAradaH ॥ puRyaSloko mahArAjastena cEtat prakIrttitam । sAttvataH sattvasampannaH kOSalyAn suzuve sutAt ॥ anDakaM vEmahaM BojaM vizRuM devAvfDaM nfpam ॥” iti kOrmme pUrvvaBAge yaduvaMSAnukIrttane । 24 । 31 -- 36 ॥ (saNkarajAtiviSezaH । yaTA, manuH । 10 । 23 । “vESyAttu jAyate vrAtyAt suDanvAcAryya evaca । kArUzaSca vijanmA ca mEtraH sAttvata evaca ॥”)
v: tri॰ sattvameva sAttvaM tattanoti tana--qa । 1 vizRO trikA॰ yaduvaMSye aMSuputre 2 nfpaBede “aTAMSoH sAttvato nAma vizRuBaktaH pratApavAn” kUrmapu॰ 22 a॰ । tadvaMSye 3 balarAme hemaca॰ । “sattvaM sattvASrayaM sattvaguRaM seveta keSavam । yo'nanyatvena manasA sAttvataH sa udAhftaH” ityukte 4 vizRuBaktaBede । 5 sAttvatanfpADizWitadeSe so'Bijano'sya aR । pitrAdikrameRa 6 taddeSavAsini ca trikA॰ । yadurvaSyotpannatvena 7 SiSupAlamAtari strI NIp । “na dUye sAttvatImUnuH” mAGaH । sA ca nAwakasya 8 vfttiBede ca । tasyA lakzaRAdi sA॰ da॰ uktaM yaTA “sAttvatI bahulA sattvaSOryyatyAgadayArjavEH । saharzA kzudraSfNgArA viSokA sA smftA taTA । utTApako'Ta soGAtyaH saMlApa parivarttakaH । viSeza iti catvAraH sAttvatyAH parikIrttitAH । uttejanakarI SatrorvAgutTApaka ucyate । mantrArTadEvaSaktyAdeH sAMGAtyaH saNGaBedanam । saMlApaH syAd gaBIroktirnAnABAvasamASrayaH । prArabDa danyakAryyARAM karaRaM parivarttakaH” । talope ekatakAro'pi । 9 jAtiBede puMstrI॰ suDanvAcAryyaSabde dfSyam ।

s: sAttvikI

s: sAttvikaH

puM, (sattvAt sattvaguRapraDARAt vizRorBUtaH । sattva + WaY .) brahmA । (sAttvaM sattvaguRo'syAstIti । Wan । vizRuH । iti mahABAratam । 13 । 149 । 106 ॥) triviDaBAvAntargataBAvaviSezaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, -- “sattvotkawe manasi ye praBavanti BAvAste sAttvikA iti vidurmmunipuNgavAste .” iti sarvvAnandaH ॥ te ca yaTA, -- “svedaH stamBo'Ta romAYcaH svaraBaNgo'Ta vepaTuH । vEvarRamaSrupralaya ityazwO sAttvikA matAH ॥” pralayo mUrcCA । iti BarataH ॥
sAttvikaH

tri, (sattvena nirvfttaH । tena nirvfttamiti WaY .) sattvaguRanizpAditaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 7 । 16 ॥ sattvaM manoguRa ASayo vA tena nizpAditaH sAttvikaH svedAdiH । sattvaSabdAt QaGe kAditi zRikaH । iti BarataH ॥ * ॥ sattvaguRayuktaH । tadvivaraRaM yaTA, gItAyAm । 17 । 4 । “yajante sAttvikA devAn yakzarakzAMsi rAjasAH । pretAn BUtagaRAMScAnye yajante tAmasA janAH ॥” sAttvikayajYo yaTA, gItAyAm । 17 । 11 । “aPalAkANkziBiryajYo viDidfzwo ya ijyate । yazwavyameveti manaH samADAya sa sAttvikaH ॥” sAttvikatapo yaTA, tatrEva । 17 । 17 । “SradDayA parayA taptaM tapastattriviDaM narEH । aPalAkANkziBiryuktEH sAttvikaM paricakzate ॥” sAttvikadAnaM yaTA, tatrEva । 17 । 20 । “dAtavyamiti yaddAnaM dIyate'nupakAriRe । deSe kAle ca pAtre ca taddAnaM sAttvikaM smftam ॥” sAttvikayogo yaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 9 । “kAryyamityeva yat karmma niyataM kriyate'rjjuna । saNgaM tyaktvA PalaYcEva sa tyAgaH sAttviko mataH ॥” sAttvikajYAnaM yaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 20 । “sarvvaBUtezu yenEkaM BAvamavyayamIkzate । aviBaktaM viBaktezu tajjYAnaM vidDi sAttvikam ॥” sAttvikakarmma yaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 23 । “niyataM saNgarahitamarAgadbezataH kftam । aPalapreysunA karmma yattat sAttvikamucyate ॥” sAttvikabudDiryaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 30 । “pravfttiYca nivfttiYca kAryyAkAryye BayABaye । banDaM mokzaYca yA vetti budDiH sA pArTa sAttvikI ॥” sAttvikI DftiryaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 33 । “DftyA yayA GArayate manaHprARendriyakriyAH । yogenAvyaBicAriRyA DftiH sA pArTa ! sAttvikI ॥” sAttvikasuKaM yaTA, tatrEva । 18 । 37 । “yattadagre vizamiva pariRAme'mftopamam । tat suKaM sAttvikaM proktamAtmabudDiprasAdajam ॥” sAttvikapurARAni yaTA, -- “vEzRavaM nAradIyaYca taTA BAgavataM SuBam । gAruqaYca taTA pAdmaM vArAhaM SuBadarSane । sAttvikAni purARAni vijYeyAni SuBAni vE ॥” sAttvikasmftayo yaTA, -- “vASizWaYcEva hArItaM vyAsaM pArASaraM taTA । BAradvAjaM kASyapaYca sAttvikA muktidAH SuBAH ॥” iti pAdmottaraKaRqe 43 aDyAyaH ॥ sAttvikapriyAhArA yaTA, -- “AyuHsattvabalArogyasuKaprItivivardDanAH । rasyAH snigDAH sTirA hfdyA AhArAH sAttvikapriyAH ॥” iti SrIBagavadgItAyAm । 17 । 8 ॥ sAttvikakarttA karttfSabde sAttvikAhAra AhAraSabde ca drazwavyaH ॥
v: pu॰ sattvAt sattvaguRapraDAnAt vizRorBavati WaY । 1 caturmuKe brahmaRi hemaca॰ । tasya vizRunABikamalajatvAt taTAtvam । sattvameva sAttvamastyasya Wan । 2 vizRO । sattvaguRena tatkAryyeRa manasA vA nirvfttaH WaY । 3 sattvaguRajAte 4 sattvapraDAnamanoviSezajAte ca । 5 SfNgArAdirasAnuguRe BAvaBede sA॰ da॰ “uktAH strIRAmalaNkArA aNgajASca svaBAvajAH । tadrUpAH sAttvikA BAvAstaTA cezwAH parA api । vikArAH sattvasamBUtAH sAttvikAH parikIrttitAH । sattvamAtrodBavatvAtte BinnA apyanuBAvataH । stamBaH svedo'Ta romAYcaH svaraBaNgo'Ta vepaTuH । vEvarRyamaSru pralaya ityazwO sAttvikA smftAH” । etezAM lakzaRAni tattacCabde dfSyAni । strIRAM yOvane sattvajAte 6 alaNkAraBede sA॰ da॰ “yOvane sattvajAstAsAmazwAviMSatisaMKyakAH” । alaNkAraSabde 408 pf॰ dfSyam । 7 sattvapraDAne tri॰ । 8 devIpUjABede strI “SAradI caRqikApUjA trviDA parikIrttitA । sAttviko rAjasI cEva tAmasI cati tAM SfRu । sAttviko japayajYESca nEvedyESca nirAmizEH” ti॰ ta॰ । 9 BAvaBede pu॰ “sattvotkawe manasi ye praBavanti BAvAste sAttvikA iti vidurmunipuNgavAstu” sarvAna॰ । 10 sattvapraDAne purARaBede “vEzRavaM nAradIyaYca taTA BAgavataM SuBam । gAruqaYca taTA pAdmaM vArAhaM SuBadarSane! । sAttvikAni purARAni vijYeyAni SuBAni vE । sAtvikezu purARezu vizRumAhAtmyavarRanam” upapurARaSabde dfSyam । 11 smftiBede strI “vAsizWaM cEva hArItaM vyAsaM pArASaraM taTA । BAradvAjaM kASyapaYca sAttvikyo muktidAH SuBAH” padmapu॰ utta॰ 43 a॰ । 12 durgAyAM strI NIp । 13 gItoktezu SradDAdiBedezu yaTAyaTaM tri॰ yaTA “sattvAnurUpA sarvasya SradDA Bavati BArata! । SradDAma yo'yaM puruzo yo yacCradDaH sa eva saH । yajante sAttvikA devAn” (SradDA) “AhArastvapi sarvasya triviDo Bavati priyaH । yajYastapastaTA dAnaM tezAM BedamimaM SfRu” ityupakrame “AyuHsattvabalArogyasuKaprItivivardDanAH । rasyAH snigDAH sTirA hfdyA AhArAH sAttvika priyAH” (AhAraH) “aPalAkANkziBiryajYo viDidfzwo ya ijyate । yazwavyameveti manaH samADAya sa sAttvikaH” (yajYaH) “SradDayA parayA taptaM tapastattriviDaM narEH । aPalAkANkziBiryuktEH sAttvikaM paricakzate” (kAyikAdi triviDaM tapaH) “dAtavyamiti yaddAnaM dIyate'nupakAriRe । deSe kAle ca pAtre ca taddAnaM sAttvikaM matam” (dAnam) “sarvaBUtezu yenEkaM BAvamavyayamIkzate । aviBaktaM viBaktezu tajjYAnaM vidDi sAttvikam” (jYAnam) “niyataM saNgarahitamarAgadvezataH kftam । aPalaprepsunA karma yattat sAttvikamucyate” (karma) “muktasaNgo'nahaMvAdI DftyutsAhasamanvitaH । sidDyasidDyornirvikAraH karttA sA ttvika ucyate” (karttA) “pravfttiM ca nivfttiM ca kAryyAkAryye BayABaye । banDaM mokzaM ca yA vetti budDiH sA pArTa! sAttvikI” (budDiH) “DftyA yayA DArayate manaH prARendriyakriyAH । yogenAvyaBicAriRyA DftiH sA pArTa! sAttvikI” (DftiH) “yattadagre vizamiva pariRABe'mftopamam । tat suKaM sAttvikaM proktamAtmabudDiprasAdajam” (suKam) “kAryyamityeva yat karma niyata kurute'rjuna! । saNgaM tyaktvAPalaM cEva sa tyAgaH sAttviko mataH” (tyAgaH) । tatra sAttvikAhArasya cittaSudDO hetutvaM CAndo॰ uktaM yaTA “AhAraSudDO satavaSudDiH sattvaSudDO DruvA smftiH” । sattvaM manaH । “annamayaM hi sOmya! manaH ityAdinA” tasya annamayatvasya tatroktestaTAtvam । sAKyamatAsadDe sattvapraDAne 14 mahattattave 15 ahaNkAratattave ca “sAttivakI rAjasaScEva tAmasaSca triDA mahAn” sAM॰ pra॰ DftavAkyam । “sAttvikamekAdaSakaM pravarttate vEkftAdahaNkArAt” sAM॰ sU॰ ekAdaSAnAM pUraRamekAdaSakaM manaH zoqaSAtmagaRamaDye sAttivakam । atastadvEkftAt sAttivakAhaNkArAjjAyata ityarTaH । “vEkArikastEjasaSca tAmasaScetyahaM triDA । ahantattavAdvikurvARAnmano vekArikAdaBUt । vEkArikASca ye devA arTABivyaYjanaM yataH” sA॰ pra॰ Da॰ vAkyam । 16 aDyavasAyAdO ca “aDyavasAyo budDirDamo jYAnaM virAga ESvaryyam । sAttivakametadrUpaM tAmasamasmAdviparyyastam” sAM॰ kA॰ । “sAttvika ekAdaSakaH pravarttate vEkftAdahaNkArAt । BUtAdestanmAtraH sa tAmasastEjasAduBayam” sAM॰ kA॰ “prakASalAGavAByAmekAdaSaka indriyagaRaH sAttviko vEkftAt sAttivakAdahaNkArAt pravarttate” tattavakO॰ ।
m: सात्त्विक mf(ई)n. (fr. सत्-त्व) spirited, vigorous, energetic, Mn.; MBh. &c.

relating to or endowed with the quality Sattva (i.e. ‘purity’ or ‘goodness’), pure, true, genuine, honest, good, virtuous (also applied to partic. Purāṇas which exalt Viṣṇu, IW. 513), MaitrUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c. internal, caused by internal feeling or sentiment, Mālatīm.
natural, not artificial, unaffected (as style), Sāh.

सात्त्विक m. a state of body caused by some natural emotion (constituting a class of 8 Bhāvas holding a middle place between the Sthāyi- and Vyabhicāri-bhāvas, viz. स्तम्भ, स्वेद, रोमाञ्च, स्वर-विकार, वेपथु, वर्ण-विकार, अश्रु, प्रलय, qq.vv.), ib.
N. of Brahmā, L.
of the eighth creation by Prajā-pati, MW.
सात्त्विक n. an offering or oblation (without pouring water), L.
a: सात्त्विक — a. (की f.) [सत्त्वगुणेन तत्कार्येण मनसा वा निर्वृत्तः ठञ्] 1 Real, essential. --2 True, genuine, natural. --3 Honest, sincere, good. --4 Virtuous, amiable. --5 Vigorous. --6 Endowed with the quality Sattva (goodness). --7 Belonging to or derived from the Sattva quality; ये चैव सात्त्विका भावाः Bg. 7. 12, 14. 16. --8 Caused by internal feeling or sentiment (as of love), internal; तद्भूरिसात्त्विकविकारमपास्तधैर्यमाचार्यकं विजयि मान्मथमाविरासीत् Māl. 1. 26. --कः 1 An external indication of (internal) feeling or emotion, one of the kinds of Bhāvas in poetry; these are eight: --स्तंभः स्वेदोऽथ रोमांचः स्वरभंगोऽथ वेपथुः . वैवर्ण्यमश्रु प्रलय इत्यष्टौ सात्त्विकाः स्मृताः .. see S. D. 164 also. --2 A Brāhmaṇa. --3 N. of Brahman. --की N. of Durgā.

k.v: अङ्गहारोऽङ्गविक्षेपो व्यञ्जकाभिनयौ समौ। निर्वृत्ते त्वङ्गसत्त्वाभ्यां द्वे त्रिष्वाङ्गिकसात्त्विके॥

m: सात्त्विक—ब्रह्म-विद्या-विलास m. N. of wk.
सात्त्विक—पुराण-विभाग m. N. of wk.
सातु m. (prob.) the womb (as conceiving), RV.
सातु See p. 1196, col. 3.

m: सात्वत् m. pl. (cf. सत्वत्) N. of a people, Hariv.; Śiś. (= यदु, Sch.)
a: सात्वत् — m. 1 A follower, worshipper (of Kṛṣṇa &c.). --2 A man of the Yādava tribe.

m: सात्वताचार-वादार्थ m. N. of wk. (also called भक्ति-विलास-तत्त्व-दीपिका, deprecating the slaughter of animals even in sacrifices, by Maheśa-nārāyaṇa).
सात्वती (ई), f., see below.
सात्वती f. a princess of the Satvats (N. of the mother of Śiśu-Pāla), MBh.; Śiś.

(scil. वृत्ति, q.v.) one of 4 divisions of dramatic style (expressive of ‘bravery, generosity, cheerfulness, and the marvellous’ ; it is of four kinds, viz. उत्थापक, संघात्य, परिवर्तक, and संलाप), Bhar.; Daśar.; Sāh.
a: सात्वती — 1 N. of one of the four dramatic styles; see S. D. 416. --2 N. of the mother of Śiśupāla; Śi. 2. 11.

m: सात्वती—सूनु m. ‘son of Sātvatī’, N. of Śiśu-pāla, Śiś.
सात्वतीय m. an adherent of Satvata i.e. Kṛṣṇa, BhP.
सात्वत mf(ई)n. relating to the Satvats or the SAtvatas, belonging or sacred to SAtvata or Kṛṣṇa &c., MBh.; Pur.
containing the word सत्वत्, g. विमुक्तादि

(pl.) N. of a people, Śiś. (= यादव, Sch.)
an adherent or worshipper of Kṛṣṇa, L.
a partic. mixed caste (the offspring of an outcaste Vaiśya; accord. to L., ‘the son of an outcaste V˚ and a V˚ woman who was formerly the wife of a Kṣatriya’), Mn. x, 43
N. of a son of Āyu or Aṃśu, Pur.

सात्वत—संहिता—प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
सात्वत—सिद्धान्त-शतक n. N. of a Vedānta wk.
सात्विक &c. See सात्त्विक, col. 1.

m: सात्यकि m. (fr. सत्यक) patr. of Yuyudhāna (a warrior in the Pāṇḍu army who acted as the charioteer of Kṛṣṇa and belonged to the Vṛṣṇi family), MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
a: सात्यकिः — N. of a Yādava warrior, who acted as charioteer to Kṛṣṇa, and took part with the Pāṇḍavas in the great war.

सात्य—मुनि m. a patr. (perhaps w.r. for सात्यमुग्रि), Saṃskārak.
सात्य—रथि m. patr. fr. सत्यरथ, VP.
